g.text: Agile work uses short inspection cycles and a shared definition of completed value

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Scrum-informed conceptual cycle, not a complete framework specification. The Sprint contains planning, daily inspection/adaptation, review, and
retrospective. Burndown values and points are synthetic; points are a team-local estimate rather than delivered value or cross-team productivity. Changes
and acceptance criteria must preserve a usable completed increment.
